constraints.message: Your army must include at least 1 Vehicle with the Super Heavy (x) special rule.
You must include 3 Infantry type units per vehicle in your Army with the Super Heavy (x) special rule.

publications.name: The Long War – Codex Supplement Iron Hands

rules.name: Bitter History
rules.description:
• An Iron Hands army gains the Limited: 1 per army special rule on the following units:
 o Tactical Terminators.
 o Assault Terminators.
• Iron Hands Space Marine Captains may not purchase the Chapter Master upgrade.
• Iron Hands Space Marine Lieutenants may not purchase the Chaplain upgrade.

rules.name: Flesh is Weak
rules.description:
All Iron Hands units in your army gain the following benefits:
• All Infantry, Bike, Walker and Cavalry type units gain the Bionics Wargear (which confers the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule).
• All Vehicle, Aircraft type units ignore any results of Crew Injury on the Vehicle damage table and treat it as a Superficial damage result instead.

sharedRules.name: Gorgon Terminator Armour
sharedRules.description: This wargear confers a 2+ Armour save and a 5+ Invulnerable save. The model gains the Relentless, Bulky (2) and Deep Strike special rules. A model equipped with this wargear may not perform Sweeping Advances. When a model with this wargear makes a Successful save in the Shooting Phase, all enemy units within 6” of the model count as being hit by a weapon with the Blind special rule. The model gains the Terminator Keyword.

rules.name: Iron Father
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS), Weapon Skill (WS), Wounds (W), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. The unit gains a Servo Arm. Additionally, the unit gains the Battle Smith (1), Priest (1), Hatred, Stubborn, Zealot and Master of Command special rule

rules.name: Blessed Autosimulacra
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Regeneration Special rule. In addition, each time the unit suffers a Wound or Penetrating hit, it can roll a D6. On a 5+ that Wound or Penetrating hit is ignored.

rules.name: Adept of the Omnissiah
rules.description: The Warlord with this trait gains the Battle Smith (1) special rule. If they already have the Battle Smith (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

rules.name: All Flesh is Weakness
rules.description: The Warlord with this trait gains the Feel no Pain (4+) special rule. In addition, the Warlord gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Targeting Protocols
rules.description: A Warlord with this trait and any attached unit always makes Snap Shots at Ballistic Skill (BS) 2 instead of 1. In addition, the Warlord and any attached unit gain +6” to the range of all Shooting weapons they are equipped with except for Grenade type weapons.

rules.name: Custodians of the Iron Council
rules.description: This unit may be joined by Iron Hands units with the Character special rule even if they are not Automata type. While an Infantry type character is attached to this unit, they ignore the standard rules for Automata targeting for Shooting and Charging. This unit does not take up a Force Organization slot if your army includes a Space Marine Captain upgraded to an Iron Father.

rules.name: The Iron Stone
rules.description: At the start of the equipped model Shooting Phase, select a singe friendly Vehicle, Aircraft or Walker within 12”. Immediately apply 1 of the effects of the Rite of Repair (see Machine Rites) without performing a Machine Rite. This does not count towards the number of Machine Rites a unit can perform per Shooting Phase.

rules.name: The Gorgons Chain
rules.description: Attacks against a model with this wargear is resolved at -1 Strength.

rules.name: The Tempered Helm
rules.description: A model with this wargear may select a single friendly unit within 24” at the start of the Movement Phase. That unit automatically passes all Pinning and Panic tests until the start of your next Movement Phase.

rules.name: The Aegis Ferrum
rules.description: A model with this wargear ignores the first wound assigned to it per Phase.

rules.name: Blessing of the Machine
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is successfully cast, select a single friendly Vehicle or Aircraft unit within 24” of the Psyker. That unit ignores the effects of the Crew Injury result on the damage table until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Machine Curse
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is successfully cast, select a single enemy Vehicle or Aircraft unit within 12” of the Psyker. All friendly Iron Hands units are treated as having the Tank Hunter special rule when resolving attacks against the targeted unit until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Reforge
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is successfully cast, select a single friendly Vehicle or Aircraft unit within 12” of the Psyker. That unit gains the benefit of the Rite of Repair as if the Rite of Repair had been successfully performed on the target. (see Machine Rites)

rules.name: Warp Metal Armour
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is successfully cast, select a single enemy Vehicle, Walker or Aircraft unit within 12” of the Psyker. The target unit gains +1 to its Armour Facings (AV) or Toughness (T) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
